citations.quote: Northbridge Synthetic Group is the issuer and consolidated group.

limitations: Unaudited without auditor; borrower, guarantor and restricted perimeters unavailable.

minimum_cash.rationale: A cash cushion of this size is held as an analyst assumption for operating needs and is not a source figure.

assessments.text: Cash is the only liquidity source because there is no revolving credit facility, so the runway rests on operating cash flow covering capital spending and distributions.
assessments.credit_implication: Distributions absorb the free cash flow the business generates, leaving little internal capacity to build a liquidity cushion or reduce debt early.

assessments.text: The single term loan is the whole debt stack and falls due on one date after the horizon assessed, so no repayment is scheduled inside it.
assessments.credit_implication: Debt service inside the horizon is limited to interest, because no principal falls due before the horizon ends.

assessments.text: Cash alone covers the assumed minimum cash with room to spare, so no external funding need is identified inside the horizon.
assessments.credit_implication: The absence of committed undrawn funding means any shortfall beyond the horizon would depend on lender consent, so headroom should be monitored each period.

minimum_cash.rationale: A cash cushion of this size is held as an analyst assumption for operating needs and is not a source figure.

assessments.text: Cash is the only liquidity source because there is no revolving credit facility, so the runway rests on operating cash flow covering capital spending and distributions.
assessments.credit_implication: Distributions absorb the free cash flow the business generates, leaving no internal capacity to repay principal at maturity.

assessments.text: The single term loan is the whole debt stack and falls due inside the horizon assessed, as one payment of the full principal.
assessments.credit_implication: A single bullet maturity concentrates repayment risk on one date and requires resources the issuer does not hold today.

assessments.text: Resources at the horizon end fall short of the assumed minimum cash once the term loan falls due, so an external funding need is identified.
assessments.credit_implication: The shortfall equals the amount that must be raised or extended, and no committed undrawn facility exists to absorb it.
